name: AWS EKS Payment Cluster (payment-cluster-prod)
documentation: An Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) managed cluster serving as the primary container orchestration execution environment for the payment system in production. Named 'payment-cluster-prod', it is associated with an IAM role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/eks-cluster-role) granting it necessary AWS API permissions. This node hosts containerized application workloads and provides compute, scheduling, and networking infrastructure via the Kubernetes control plane and worker nodes managed by AWS.
